notes.default: GN variant disabled by default. Chromium runtime feature is unchanged. Callback admits only the exact native-owned wrapper; per-WC attachment fact survives wrapper/destructor ordering.
notes.canonical_release_series: Receipt requires exact canonical Electron chromium patch series plus the complete final source delta against the pinned commits. Fragment application does not prove release-series composition or native compilation.
notes.native_history: Third required held source patch. Native SQLite/GUID reader and Session writer are consumed by the package observer in source. Native core/spec and current consumer tests remain unexecuted; existing bundles and Home are untouched.
notes.navigation_history: Fourth required held source patch: optional explicit source collector, actual native commit/title evidence, isolated room Sessions, independent admitted reads. No native build/spec/activation performed.

source_prepare: verifySourceCheckout replays the pinned canonical Electron Chromium patch series plus foundation+production+download-history+navigation-history in private temporary Git indexes AND object stores, using actual base objects read-only as alternates. It compares tracked source composition without changing real indexes/objects. Full checkout dependency preparation/native compilation is still unperformed.

build_request.sourceRoot: explicit canonical Chromium source root with pinned Electron release dependencies and source patches applied

toolchain.compiler: canonical actual Chromium clang++ executable (read back from generated native compile command)
toolchain.sdk_settings: canonical actual SDKSettings.json used by compile -isysroot
toolchain.python: canonical Python3 for POSIX compile-command tokenization

phases: verify-source validates actual canonical release-source composition
build runs GN/Ninja and issues compiled-unaccepted candidate tied to actual compiler command and source hashes
native-spec explicitly executes ONLY the owned native spec with the candidate engine, own temporary profile, no broad upstream cleanup/test flags
accept validates actual native spec result and separately owner-accepted physical input evidence, then publishes owned-engine.json
package-macos.cjs requires OCTOPUS_OWNED_ELECTRON_RECEIPT; stock engine is not selected
recipe.status: source implemented; no full checkout composition/build/spec/acceptance performed
